r1cs.macro_expansion: construction order; fixed primitive expansions in this manifest; rotations/byte permutations are aliases only

macros.add(k): k sum bits and k carry bits are allocated and bit-constrained; one add_lsb plus k-1 add_carry rows
macros.alias(k): k parser-synthesized constants or pure column aliases; zero rows, variables, and nonzeros
macros.allocation: invocation order, lane index, then primitive order; every declared derived output is a fresh auxiliary variable
macros.and(k): k AND rows and k derived output bits
macros.digest_nonzero_cond(k): nonzero(k) followed by one implication row
macros.digest_unequal_cond(k): k XOR, k-1 OR, one implication row
macros.is_equal(k): k XOR, k-1 OR, one NOT; 2k derived bits
macros.is_zero(k): k-1 OR and one NOT; k derived bits
macros.keccak_f1600: per permutation: 115200 XOR, 38400 AND-NOT, and 86 fixed-Iota NOT rows; rotations and lane permutations alias columns
macros.le(k): lt(k) plus one NOT-derived result bit
macros.lt(k): MSB-first ripple using k each of XOR, AND-NOT, NOT, AND, OR; 5k derived bits
macros.nonzero(k): k-1 OR-derived reduction bits; caller binds the result
macros.not(k): k NOT rows and k derived output bits
macros.onehot_select5(k): five AND rows plus one six-term linear output row per bit
macros.or(k): k OR rows and k derived output bits
macros.select(k): k selector rows and k derived output bits
macros.selected_asset4(k): four AND rows plus one conditional four-term linear equality per bit
macros.xor(k): k odd-field XOR rows and k derived output bits

r1cs.matrix_encoding: row-major; each linear combination is sorted unique (column,8-byte-canonical-field-element) pairs; reject duplicates, zero coefficients, noncanonical elements, or columns outside z
r1cs.variable_order: z[0]=1; z[1..l]=public bits; private transport bits; derived auxiliary variables in group/invocation/primitive construction order
